title: EpisodeThumbnailConfig
description: Mandatory thumbnail and opening frame branding configuration for Papercraft Content Factory episodes.

channelName.description: Mandatory brand channel name. Must be exactly '@meowndr'.

mascotAsset.description: Relative path to the canonical orange-and-cream Cat Scientist reference asset.

episodeTitle.description: Actual episode video title in Indonesian (or episode language). Must be non-empty and faithful.

thumbnailHook.description: Optional concise supporting curiosity hook phrase.

mainSubject.description: Topic-specific visual focus (object or phenomenon) depicted in the papercraft scene.

mascotExpression.description: Topic-appropriate facial pose and expression for the Cat Scientist mascot.

layoutPreset.description: Reusable branded composition preset for YouTube 16:9 layout.

width.description: Width of the standalone YouTube thumbnail in pixels.

height.description: Height of the standalone YouTube thumbnail in pixels.

openingFrameDurationSeconds.description: Duration of the opening thumbnail frame in seconds.

openingFrameDurationFrames.description: Duration of the opening thumbnail frame in frames (30 fps).
